description: Eight cabin saunas from €6,391 (Sauna S) to €15,892 (Sauna XL): Pulse, Zen, Nova and Amber with 44 mm pine log walls, and the S, M, L and XL series in 45 × 185 mm profiled spruce beams with a modern low-pitch roof. For 2–4 people, or 4–8 on Sauna L and XL. Delivered to the UK, Ireland and Europe. Compact cabins. Sauna S and M (sauna room 2.09 × 2.09 m) and Pulse (2.39 × 3.34 m) suit a small garden. Nova (3.34 × 2.39 m) adds a 150 × 198 cm glazed panel; Zen has a double glazed door and three windows. Room to rest. Sauna L (4.13 × 2.09 m sauna room, 2 rooms) and Sauna XL (3.58 × 4.63 m, 3 rooms, building 4.28 × 7.63 m) have a separate room for changing or cooling down. Amber has 16.3 m² inside under a 25.6 m² roof. Glazing and doors. The S–XL series uses tempered glass packages and 8 mm glass sauna doors; Pulse, Nova and the pod use tempered double-glazed windows. Heater. Wood-fired heaters give the traditional heat and work without electricity; electric heaters are simpler to run and need a qualified electrician. Smaller or quicker: barrel saunas and the sauna pod. Prices explained: garden sauna costs.
